name: Lunar127 Virtual BigTIFF Raster
coordinateModel: paired unsigned 64-bit X/Y coordinates; no flattened 64-bit pixel index required

bigtiffBoundary.reason: Raster dimensions exceed common uint32 ImageWidth/ImageLength APIs and fully materialized bytes exceed unsigned 64-bit file-offset space.
bigtiffBoundary.strategy: VBT-1 keeps the virtual coordinate space in a manifest/procedural kernel and materializes only requested tiles/viewports as ordinary BigTIFF shards.
